LAYOUT: a horizontal strip of EXACTLY THREE equal-width panels in one row, separated by clean cream gutters. No drawn borders. One consistent warm workshop, one consistent pair of people, one consistent glowing amber laptop across all three panels, reading left to right.

THE TWO PEOPLE (same in every panel): LEFT, a planner: a man in his fifties with short grey hair, round glasses, a brown sweater vest over a cream shirt. RIGHT, a builder: a woman in her thirties with curly dark hair tied back, wearing a rust-red sweater and dark trousers. ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

THE CHIEF (inside the laptop only): a small translucent holographic coral-orange rounded mascot with a grand gold admiral hat, gold epaulettes, warm dot eyes, stubby legs, short nub arms ending in rounded MITTEN stubs, never fingers. He only listens, commands and oversees; he never does the task work himself. He never leaves the screen.

BEAT ONE (left): Two wooden desks side by side in a warm workshop. At the left desk the planner studies a thick bound plan, papers squared into neat piles, his own laptop closed and dark. At the right desk the builder slides a rough, visibly unfinished page toward her open glowing translucent amber laptop; inside the screen the small chief raises one mitten stub and a circle of tiny rounded agent figures begins to turn like a wheel.

BEAT TWO (middle): Closer on the builder's glowing laptop. Inside the screen the wheel of tiny agents turns; one agent pins a small card onto a growing board of pinned cards inside the screen, lessons accumulating; from the laptop's side a short stack of finished pages has emerged, each page visibly cleaner and brighter than the one beneath it. Outside the glow the builder points at the newest page, deciding the next change.

BEAT THREE (right): Wide shot. The builder's desk and glowing laptop now stand on a raised wooden platform of ascending steps; beneath the platform, large gears turn on their own, lifting it higher. Inside the laptop the wheel of agents still turns and the board of pinned cards is full. Far below on the flat ground the planner stands holding his bound plan, looking up at her.

Caption under left panel: ONE PLANS. ONE LOOPS.
Caption under middle panel: EVERY PASS TEACHES
Caption under right panel: THE FLOOR RISES
Footer bar below, caps: ITERATE FAST. BUILD SYSTEMS THAT LEARN.
